_doc: KEYWORD GLOSSARY. Words in card / item / hint / branch text that match a keyword's name or alias (case-sensitive, whole word; longest first) are shown BOLD + coloured, and hovering one for ~0.7s shows its tooltip (text includes numbers and stacking rules). In the battle hand, hovering a card also lists its keywords beside the zoomed card. 'ops' links card effect ops to a keyword (tests require the keyword to appear highlighted in that card's text). Add a keyword = add an entry here; no code change.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.text: Damage over time. At the start of its turn the unit takes damage equal to its Bleed stacks, then loses 1 stack. Stacks add up, so apply it early. Payoffs: Gore, Open Vein, Blood Sigil. Hits from behind can add more.

poison.name: Poison
poison.text: Damage over time: 2 damage at the start of each turn. Each stack is one turn, so stacks add duration. Not removed by blocking.

weaken.name: Weaken
weaken.text: The unit deals 25% less damage. Counts down 1 each turn; stacks add turns.

expose.name: Expose
expose.text: The unit takes 50% more damage (and ignores Armor). Counts down 1 each turn.

stun.name: Stun
stun.text: The unit skips its next turn and any charging attack is interrupted. Counts down 1 per turn.

web.name: Web
web.text: Sticky silk: -2 movement for the number of turns shown. Slows prey so you can catch (or escape) it.

slow.name: Slow
slow.text: Reduced movement or turn rate. Web takes 2 movement away; Daze halves it; slow turners need extra turns to face you, so circle around behind them.

daze.name: Daze
daze.text: The unit deals half damage and moves half as far. Counts down 1 each turn.

fear.name: Fear
fear.text: The unit flees instead of attacking and any charge is cancelled. Bosses resist Fear.

mark.name: Mark
mark.text: Your next hit on a Marked enemy deals +3 damage (more with Hunter's Lens); the Mark is then used up. Lasts a few turns.

infection.name: Infection
infection.text: The asteroid parasite. Infected enemies have +30% HP, +2 damage and spread it to neighbours. Spores on you deal 1 damage per turn (wash off in water); eating an infected corpse gives you spores.

exhaust.name: Exhaust
exhaust.text: The card is removed from your draw cycle for the rest of this battle after it is played. Powers always exhaust.

ambush.name: Ambush
ambush.text: Strike from hiding before they notice you: your first hit on an unaware enemy is free and hits hard (base x2 plus Stalker, items). Staying in tall grass keeps you hidden.

unspotted.name: Unspotted
unspotted.text: No enemy has noticed you. Many cards deal bonus damage to enemies that have not spotted you, and unaware enemies cannot dodge.

backstab.name: Backstab
backstab.text: Hitting an enemy from behind multiplies damage (x1.5 by default; some cards go x2 or x3). Enemies face one of four directions: walk around them.

flank.name: Flank
flank.text: Hits from the side deal +25% damage (x1.25) and from behind +50% unless a card says otherwise. Many cards and items add flat bonus damage for flanking.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.text: Chance to avoid a single-target attack (and its Bleed, Poison, Web...). Tall grass gives 25%. Area attacks cannot be dodged and unaware enemies cannot dodge.

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.text: While no enemy has spotted you, your attacks deal extra damage (+3 per Stalker played). Lost the moment you are spotted.

calm.name: Calm
calm.text: The first attack each turn made while unspotted refunds 1 stamina.

hide.name: Hide
hide.text: Vanish into tall grass: enemies 2+ tiles away lose sight of you. You stay hidden until you attack or are found.

block.name: Block
block.text: Absorbs damage before HP is lost. Block is removed at the start of your next turn.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.text: Tiles you have moved this turn. Cards like Rending Charge and Second Wind, and items like Momentum Boots, turn distance travelled into damage.

armor.name: Armor
armor.text: Flat damage taken off every hit from the front. Flank it, or Expose it to ignore armor.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.text: Pays for cards. Refills fully at the start of your turn; Low hunger costs 1.

hunger.name: Hunger
hunger.text: Drops every room you enter. Low hunger slows you and costs stamina; starving hurts. Eat corpses and forage to refill.

diet.name: Diet
diet.text: Rolling quality of your last meals: Poor, Fair, Good, Excellent. Better diets earn bonus XP, power Scavenger cards and unlock evolution branches.

area.name: Area attack
area.text: Hits everything in its area. Cannot be Evaded.

leap.name: Leap
leap.text: Jumps over obstacles to land next to a target. Needs a minimum distance (not usable at melee range) and may land you behind the target.

retreat.name: Retreat
retreat.text: Move away from enemies after acting, preferring tall grass. Hit-and-Run cards combine strike + retreat.

telegraph.name: Telegraph
telegraph.text: Heavy attacks are announced a turn ahead: the danger tiles turn red. Step out of them (or Stun / Fear the enemy) and the blow is wasted.

pack.name: Pack
pack.text: Pack hunters deal +1 damage for each ally also adjacent to you (max +2). Fight them in a corridor or pick them off one by one.

power.name: Power
power.text: Stays active for the rest of the battle once played; then exhausts.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.text: Archetype: eat well. Cards and items that pay off a Good diet and heal or draw when you feed.

tempo.name: Tempo
tempo.text: Archetype: cheap, fast cards, extra moves and extra turns.
